Method of Attack: Remote access tool (RAT) functionality allowing operator access to infected machines
Disguised as a legitimate antivirus solution to scan and remove Pegasus spyware traces
Enables direct access via Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) and Virtual Network Computing (VNC)
Impacted Systems: Users infected with Pegasus spyware traces, primarily users in the U.K.
Attack Vector: Delivered through fake Amnesty International websites advertising Anti-Pegasus antivirus
Use of fake domains impersonating Amnesty International (amnestyinternationalantipegasus.com, amnestyvspegasus.com, antipegasusamnesty.com)
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Amnesty International domains: amnestyinternationalantipegasus.com, amnestyvspegasus.com, antipegasusamnesty.com
Command and control (C2) servers with limited geographic distribution
